rows.name: Blackpool Piers
rows.description: Green light on North pier, red lt. on South pier

rows.name: Fleetwood
rows.description: High lt. in town, low lt. on esplanade, N. ½ E. and S. ½ W., 850 ft. apart. Shown while 9 ft.

rows.name: Wyre River
rows.description: Red pile lighthouse on N.E. elbow of North Wharf Bank

rows.name: Lune River
rows.description: On Cockersand Point and Plover Scar Rock, while 8 ft. water. In line, E. by S. ½ S., 834 yds. apart; visible betw. S.W. and N. ½ W. A fixed bright tide light at Glasson Dock

rows.name: Grange Channel Lt.-Ves.
rows.description: In 17 feet, on N.W. side of Grange Channel, between Yeoman and Clark Wharf Spits. Approach to Morecambe. Also shows a bright light, or ball, while 8 ft. in channel to harbour

rows.name: Morecambe Harbour
rows.character: 1. One fixed bright lt. 2. Two fixed red lights 3. One fix. blue or red lt.
rows.description: 1. White stone tower, 50 ft. high, at extremity of West or stone pier 2. One 130 yds. from end of stone pier, other 1 cable from end of wooden jetty, in line lead over bar 3. On promenade pier; blue seaward, red to harbour

rows.name: MORECAMBE BAY LT.-V.
rows.character: One rev. red lt., ½ min.
rows.description: In 12 fathoms, 14¾ miles W. by S. from Walney lighthouse. Red ball at mast-head

rows.name: WALNEY ISLAND
rows.character: One rev. br. lt., 1 min. One fixed red light
rows.description: Stone lt.-house, 60 ft. high, and mast, on S.E. point. In one, N.W. by W. ¾ W., 440 yards apart. Red lt. vis. to S. betw. W. and N.E.

rows.name: Piel Bar Lightvessel
rows.description: A small lightvessel, moored in 4 fathoms, about 3 cables seaward of Lightning Knoll Three sets of fixed bright leading lights, and several buoys bearing gas lights, mark direction of dredged channel

rows.name: Piel Harbour
rows.description: Bright lt. on Michael Scar. Red lt. on pier, br. to S.S.E. and N.W. in direction of channel

rows.name: Barrow
rows.character: 1. One fixed bright lt. 2. One fixed red light 3. One fixed red light 4. One fixed green lt.
rows.description: 1. On East side of channel to Barrow, 1 mile N.W. ½ W. from Piel pier light 2. At Devonshire Dock entrance, 2 hours before to 2 hours after high water 3. At Ramsden Dock, when gates open 4. Pier on West side of Barrow Island

rows.name: SELKER ROCKS LT.-V.
rows.description: In 10½ fms., 3 miles W. ½ N. from Selker Point. A diamond at mast-head. Light shows one bright and one red flash every ½ minute

rows.name: ST. BEES HEAD
rows.character: One occulting bright lt., ½ min.
rows.description: White tower, 55 ft. high. Light eclipsed twice in quick succession, followed by 24 secs. lt.; masked East of South (nearly), or one-third of a mile outside Selker Rocks

rows.name: Whitehaven
rows.character: 1. One rev. br. lt., 2 m. 2. One fixed green light 3. One fixed red light
rows.description: 1. White tower, 47 ft. high, on West pier-head. 2. On North pier-head 3. On Old Quay; half-flood to half-ebb; red flag by day

rows.name: Harrington
rows.description: On pier-head, while 8 ft. water. Red drum at inner end of pier by day

rows.name: Workington, Tide Lights
rows.character: 1. One fixed bright lt. 2. Fix. green and red lts.
rows.description: 1. On end of St. John's breakwater, while 8 ft. water; red ball at pier 2. Two green lights in one lead in. A red light on Old pier, South side of river

rows.name: Maryport
rows.character: 1. Two fixed lights 2. One fixed bright lt. 3. Two fixed lights
rows.description: 1. Bright light on outer end of South pier, and red light on outer end of North pier 2. Tide light on inner end of South pier, wLile 8 ft. water in the harbour. If entrance obstructed, a red light is shown 12 ft. below 3. Green light on jetty on South side of harbour; red light on Tongue pier, on North side, while 8 ft. water

rows.name: Solway Lightvessel
rows.description: In 5 fathoms, in Robin Rigg Channel. Black, with ball

rows.name: Lee Scar
rows.description: On piles, on the rocks

rows.name: Skinburness
rows.description: A white building, 32 ft. high, on Cott or Silloth Point

rows.name: Silloth
rows.description: Yellow gas light on wooden pier, changed to green when 12 feet on dock sill. Two red lights in line lead through dock entrance
